quizzes.question_text: The point G(1,4) is rotated 90° counterclockwise around the origin. What are the coordinates of the resulting point, G'= (___ ___)
solution: 90° is $\frac{1}{4}$ of a full turn. The rotation will turn the point $\frac{1}{4}$ of a full turn in the counterclockwise direction.
Start with the point G(1,4).

Rotate the point 90° counterclockwise around the origin. The point will move from Quadrant I to Quadrant II. To find the exact location, imagine (0, 0) and G forming opposite corners of a box. Rotate the box, keeping the (0, 0) corner fixed.
G' has coordinates (-4,1).

solution: 180° is $\frac{1}{2}$ of a full turn. The rotation will turn the point $\frac{1}{2}$ of a full turn in the counterclockwise direction.
Start with the point G(-3,4).

Rotate the point 180° counterclockwise around the origin. The point will move from Quadrant II to Quadrant IV. To find the exact location, imagine (0, 0) and G forming opposite corners of a box. Rotate the box, keeping the (0, 0) corner fixed.
G' has coordinates (3,-4).
